Philly just got a brand new gaming adventure 📢📢📢 and it’s WILD 🔥 @timemissi

PAX Unplugged in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the tabletop-only version of the very popular @PAX  gaming conventions.

This absolutely massive convention hall has enough games to keep you occupied for all three days of the event, and that's exactly what we did. You can demo a bunch of games, whether they're games you've always been curious about or games you've never heard of. You can speak with developers and get convention exclusive items. You can compete in a bunch of tournaments, ranging from silly speed sleeving competitions to ultra competitive TCG tournaments. And you can shop, shop, shop for all the fancy shiny cardboard.

And what's extra fun is that this is right in the heart of downtown Philly, so you can hop out for some of the delicious local foods, like Reading Terminal Market.

This is my favorite con I've been to, and I cannot wait to go back again next year.

What's your favorite board game? Let me know, and follow the page for more foodie finds and local spotlights :)

A teenage construction worker spoke to local media in North Carolina of his disbelief after he was taken from a job site by Border Patrol agents in an unmarked SUV.

“I didn’t believe it would happen to me. I was born here,” 18-year-old Fernando Vazquez told NC Newsline.

“They saw my North Carolina Real ID,” Vazquez told NC Newsline. “They were looking for an ID or some sort of documentation, so at that moment, they could have let me free. But no, they decided to take me.”

Vazquez said the agents loaded him into an SUV with another worker from the construction site, and continued questioning him as they drove away. After Vazquez told the agents he was born in Raleigh, the agents stopped the car and let him out, removing his handcuffs.

Footage here shows Vazquez having his handcuffs removed by Border Patrol agents, who then scatter the contents of his wallet onto the ground as they drive away.

Vazquez told local news that the other detainee in the SUV asked him to, “Tell my brother that they got me.”

Immigration operations in North Carolina have led to 370 arrests in the past five days, the Department of Homeland Security said.

I had a gut feeling something wasn’t right, even when her dad, who sometimes would said I was exaggerating. Something told us we needed to take her to the hospital. After a CT scan and while we waited for the results, the worst happened, she had a major seizure and was unconscious for almost six hours.

When the ambulance arrived, they said she needed to be airlifted because they didn’t have the equipment to transport her safely. We couldn’t ride with her since several pediatric specialists had to treat her during the flight.

At the hospital, she was taken straight to intensive care. Dozens of doctors and nurses rushed around her, running tests and asking what had happened. All I could say was, “She was fine… and then she wasn’t.” They found no trauma or bruise that could explain the brain bleed.

Without fully realizing it, I signed papers allowing a medically induced coma because she still wasn’t responding. I prayed, asking God for another chance. Then, as I was losing hope, I heard her crying down the hall. The doctors rushed out with her and told us to call her name. She woke up.

Later that night, we finally got answers: she has a cavernoma—a tangled vein in the brain that eventually caused the bleed.

We were blessed to get her back. Today she’s a happy, healthy little girl, and I’m so grateful I trusted my mom intuition—it may have saved her life.#whiterabbit#fyp#daughter#cavernoma#momintuition

Aquí te traigo un itinerario de un día en la ciudad de Filadelfia 🌆

Filadelfia es una ciudad que fácilmente puede recorrerse caminando🚶, en transporte  público o en bicicleta ! Y ofrece cientos de actividades ! 🤩

1️⃣Parque histórico nacional 
📍Philadelphia PA 19106 

Encuentras la mayoría de museo y sitios de interés de la ciudad ! 😎
Además de visitar de manera gratuita la famosa campana 🛎️🛎️de la libertad ! 

2️⃣Distrito fashion 
📍901 market st 

Son varias calles en donde encuentras muchas tiendas🌆 y grandes descuentos 

3️⃣Reading terminal market 
📍1136 arch at 

El mercado más famosa de la ciudad y uno de los más antiguos de USA 🇺🇸, allí encontrarás los mejores restaurantes g la comida más deliciosa ! 🍔

4️⃣City hall 
📍1401 market st 

El centro de la ciudad ! 
Grandes edificios además puedes disfrutar de una pista de patinaje en verano e invierno ! ❄️

5️⃣Love park 
Ubicado al lado del city hall , es uno de los parques más famosos de la ciudad ! Recorre sus fue tea y tomate la icónica foto en el letrero del parque 🎠

6️⃣Benjamin Franklin parkway 
Es una larga calle que atraviesa gran parte de la ciudad ! Recórrela en bicicleta 🚴o caminando ! 🚶

7️⃣Museo de arte de Philly y la estatua de Rocky balboa 🥊
📍2600 Benjamin Franklin 

Es uno de los lugares más famosos y más visitados ! ⛲️
Además de ser lugar de la estatua de Rocky ! 
Algo que debes hacer si o si es recorrer los famosos escalones y admirar la ciudad desde la cima ! 🙌🏼

Best Date Ideas in Boston and MA 📍

If you’re looking for a date out in the Boston area that doesn’t involve dinner and drinks, here are 5 cool activities you should check out.👇

1. 🔥Glass Flameworking For 2. 🗓️ + more.📍Somerville Private Glass Studio.
In this unique experience, you & a partner of your choice will learn the fundamentals of flameworking Borosilicate glass. 🔥You'll learn about the equipment, safety & steps needed to start working with glass.  Both Guests will create a finished piece on their own to keep such as marbles, beads, pendants, shot glasses, jars, magnets, ornaments, drink stirrirs & small sculptures. 🖼️

2. 🖌️Linoleum Block Printing  🗓️ 8/9 + more.📍Charlestown 
This  is a 2 1/2 hour experience that covers the basics of carving linoleum blocks, running them on the press,  troubleshooting problems, and making changes. The bonus of printing in a studio is that wood-mounted linoleum blocks are almost the exact height needed to print on a letterpress!

3.🕯️Shaped Soy Candle Making ✨🗓️  8/8 + more.📍Private Somerville Studio.
Make a unique shaped soy wax candle + a set of wax melts. Pick from seashells, bunnies, hearts, owls, bubble candles, and more fun shapes🥳 Pick your color and scent and then unmold your creations  There is also be trivia and prizes 🏆

4.🥣Build Your Own Ceramic Serving Bowls. 🗓️8/22 + more 📍Newton Private Space
Start with a lump of clay, and together learn how to hand mold it into a beautiful serving bowl.  Once you have the form made, you'll get to choose your final colors and other details.The final piece will be your own handy-work, dishwasher, microwave and oven safe!! 

5.📚Mini Bookcase Making Workshop 🗓️8/9 + more 📍 Private Art Space - Roxbury.
You'll paint and personalize your very own mini bookcase, craft and assemble miniature books, and style your shelf with tiny accessories like vases, succulents, and more. It’s the perfect blend of creativity, calm, and cuteness. 📘🪴

The Department of education, under recent legislation named “the one big beautiful bill act” redefines what qualifies as a professional degree. This directly impacts student loan eligibility and borrowing limits for people seeking out these degrees. 

The legislation introduces a two tier system for federal student loans, eliminating the graduate plus loan program that previously allowed students to borrow up to their cost of attendance. 

This makes these degrees financially unattainable for a lot of students most of which are women. This weakens the future female workforce pipeline!!!

1. My grandmother was a small girl on her family’s farm when she slipped into a running harvester. The machine was already spinning, sharp metal everywhere, and adults screamed because everyone knew what happens inside those blades. But when they pulled her out, she didn’t have a single cut. Not a bruise. Not a scrape. People stood around in silence, unable to understand how a child could go through a machine like that and come out untouched.

2. Her parents kept repeating the same words: “She should not be alive.” Farmers had seen grown men lose arms or legs. Yet a thin little girl passed through the metal and wasn’t even hurt. The doctor who checked her said he had no explanation. Everything about the accident should have caused massive injury — speed, force, metal — but her body acted as if nothing touched it.

3. Decades later, trauma researchers began studying survival in “non-survivable accidents.” A team from Johns Hopkins found that in extreme danger, the body enters a state called protective dissociation — muscles harden, reflexes speed up, and the body pulls into the smallest shape possible in under a second. Children do this even faster than adults. Their bones are more flexible, their tissues softer, and their nervous system reacts like a spring snapping tight.

4. Another study from the University of Pittsburgh showed that some people live through unbelievable accidents because of micro-timing — events aligning within milliseconds: a blade turning the other direction, a shift in body angle, a tiny delay in pressure. Doctors call it “biomechanical luck,” but many admit it feels like something more: the body choosing life with everything it has.

5. Emergency surgeons quietly say a similar sentence: “When it’s not someone’s time, nothing takes them.” Not as superstition, but as observation. They see patients survive falls, crashes, and impacts that should end life instantly — yet somehow don’t. My grandmother’s story became one of those cases. No miracle words. No big lessons. Just a child who walked out of a machine that should have ended everything — because, as doctors say, her time simply hadn’t come.

🌟 [OPENING NOVEMBER 12] Winter Wonderland Christmas Village in Dallas: Holiday at The Dallas Abroretum🌟

📍 8525 Garland Road, Dallas, Texas 75218

Why we love it:
❤️ Holiday at the Dallas Arboretum is a winter wonderland that features stunning displays and activities for all ages!
❤️ All ages will love the Christmas Village featuring a European-inspired holiday market with charming shops, live music, a scavenger hunt, and seasonal treats.
❤️ Make sure to stroll the 12 Days of Christmas exhibit, where each day is brought to life with 25-foot-tall Victorian-style gazebos decorated with intricate scenes, music, and festive lighting.

Good to know:
- The exhibit is open November 12 through January 4. Daytime and nighttime reservations are available.
- General admission ranges from $17.95 – $40 with discounts for senior citizens and children. Ages 2 and under are free. Parking is an additional $15 per vehicle plus taxes and fees.

1️⃣ Protects your shoulders – Reduces strain on the shoulder joint and keeps your rotator cuff safe when pressing heavy.

3️⃣ Improves pressing stability and power – Keeps your joints stacked and aligned, allowing you to press heavier with better control and efficiency.

Time Mission just opened in Center City, and it’s honestly one of the most fun things I’ve done in Philly lately. There are over 25 different portals, each with its own challenge testing your speed, strength, memory, or coordination. Every game is quick, so you’re constantly moving, laughing, and trying again.

You can go solo or team up with friends, check your score on the live leaderboard, and replay any challenge as many times as you want. It’s the perfect mix of adventure, competition, and pure fun.

Now y’all… after the culinary disappointment I endured last night, I had to come restore the feeling — and Pretty Girls Cook at 1016 N. Marshall Street came through like a soulful prayer answered on a plate!

I pulled up for brunch and babyyyyyy — it was giving flavor, comfort, and REDEMPTION. I ordered the “Aquarius Jawn” (because duh, I’m an Aquarius, heavy on the JAWN), and let me tell you… those Cajun inspired shrimp and grits were creamy, cheesy, seasoned with purpose, and absolutely hit every corner of my soul.

They also slid me a fluffy pancake that was chef’s kiss — could the batter have been a little stronger? Maybe. But did I clean that plate like I had no complaints? Absolutely.

This spot is Black-owned, warm, welcoming, and the food is full of heart. So if you’re looking for your next brunch move in Philly — support Pretty Girls Cook and thank me later. Good vibes, good food, and a name that speaks for itself.

Disappointed is an understatement.
I’ve been to Booker’s Restaurant & Bar at 5021 Baltimore Ave in West Philly before, and usually, the vibes are top-tier. The food? Chef’s kiss. But today? Today really missed the mark, and I’m honestly still hungry.

Here’s what happened:
I originally ordered the smoked salmon omelet—something I had been genuinely looking forward to. After waiting 30 minutes, the server finally came back just to tell me they didn’t have it. So I reordered and decided to go with the chicken & waffles instead.

I asked specifically for boneless chicken—I got bone-in. The waffle was dark, dry, and crispy like it had been sitting out too long, and the shrimp were fried so hard they could’ve chipped a tooth. I also ordered cornbread which never came. Just vanished like it was never rung up. And despite all that? They still charged me $3.24 for the orange juice and wanted gratuity on top.

Now listen, I understand everyone has off days—especially in the service industry—but what made this harder to digest was that every other table around me got their food and was taken care of. Meanwhile, I left with nothing.

The server was also the bartender and handling multiple tables, so I get it—it’s a lot. But I sat in that restaurant for an hour and a half, and not one dish came out right. No resolution, no real apology, no food.

This isn’t to tear down a business—especially one I’ve supported before—but to hold space for real feedback. I want to continue supporting Booker’s because I’ve had great meals there in the past… but today was not that day.

Let’s clarify what polyphonic perception is. There have been a huge number of posts lately about this phenomenon. However, mostly these posts misunderstand what it really is. This type of perception is not simply hearing the various instruments within a musical texture. It requires the ability to hear multiple separate simultaneous melodies, and this kind of composition is relatively unusual in modern popular music. 

To be clear, I think that it is fantastic that people are listening closely to music and hearing the many different layers in a musical texture. That is a skill that one can cultivate and improve over time. While many people hear music in many different ways, it is definitely not the case that the ability to hear multiple layers in music is a special talent that is only possessed by a few. It is a skill that musicians learn all the time and is not necessarily an indicator of neurodiversity (such as ADHD) as many on this clock app have claimed. To be fair, it may be the case that some people have the ability to do this better than others, but there is much more research that needs to be done to really confirm that conclusion. In the meantime, remember that polyphonic perception is the perception of multiple simultaneous melodies, and not just multiple instruments.

venueName: biological neural networks in a dish can adapt to environmental feedback and carry out a goal
caption:
Brain Cells Can Play Pong
Researchers created DishBrain by growing about 800,000 neurons from human stem cells and embryonic mice on a high-density microelectrode array, allowing a computer to both stimulate the cells and read their activity.  The neural culture was then placed inside a simple virtual game world, Pong, where the neurons received predictable feedback when they hit the ball and random feedback when they missed.  Over only a few minutes, the cells altered their firing patterns to improve performance, demonstrating that biological neural networks in a dish can adapt to environmental feedback and carry out a goal-directed task, a phenomenon the researchers described as a form of synthetic biological intelligence.  Music composed by Bert Cole (bitbybitsound.com)  Some of the assets used: "PS1 Rat" (https://skfb.ly/oJFSy) by Neisium

These CANDIED CRANBERRIES are the ULTIMATE holiday treat!

✨Recipe:
Ingredients:
• 2 cups ginger beer
• 2 tbsp apple butter
• 2 cups fresh cranberries
• 1 cup powdered sugar
• 1 tbsp cinnamon

Directions:
1. Use a toothpick to poke a small hole in each cranberry to help them soak better. Place the berries in a lidded container, pour in the ginger beer, and add the apple butter. Seal and refrigerate for 24 hours so the cranberries can fully infuse.
2. Strain the soaked cranberries and pat them dry with paper towels. Toss them generously in powdered sugar until coated, then sprinkle with cinnamon and roll to cover evenly.
3. Spread the sugared berries on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 200°F for 7–10 minutes to set the coating.
4. Let them cool completely in the fridge for a few hours, then enjoy these cinnamon-sweet, crisp-on-the-outside treats!

Lleva:
-1K de carne molida de res
-sal, pimienta, ajo en polvo para condimentar
-aceite en aerosol
PARA LA SALSA:
-3 tomates (cocidos)
-1/4 de cebolla
-1 diente de ajo
-1 ó 2 Cdas de chipotles adobados de lata
-1/2 queso crema (95g)
-1 de media crema (225g)
-1/2 Cda de sal, orégano y sazonador
CÓMO LO HAGO:
1.	Condimentar la carne molida con sal, pimienta y ajo en polvo
2.	Hacemos las mini bolitas con Cucharada medidora (sopera)
3.	Las doramos en un sartén con un poco de aerosol y mientras preparamos la salsa
4.	Hervimos unos tomates, los llevamos a la licuadora junto con cebolla, ajo, chile chipotle, queso crema, crema, sal, orégano y sazonador
5.	Vaciamos la salsa a las albóndogas y dejamos unos minutos a que hierva
6.	Y listo, acompaña con arroz blanco y ejotes

Rinde hasta para 20 personas, ajusta las cantidades para lo que necesites
10 chiles anaheim
6 chiles poblanos
1 litro de crema
1 barra queso crema
4 dientes de ajo
1 barra de mantequilla
Sal y pimienta al gusto
1kg espagueti 
2 tazas Queso para derretir (ajusta a tu gusto)

Asa y limpia los chiles. Quita la piel y las semillas.
Pon a cocer la pasta y reserva 1 taza del agua de cocción.
Licúa con el ajo, queso crema y crema.
En una olla derrite mantequilla y agrega la salsa. 
Agrega el espagueti y si ves muy espesa tu salsa puedes agregar agua de la cocción de la pasta.
Al final agrega queso y derrite.

Green Spaghetti Espagueti Verde Pasta Mexicana 🥰
If you haven't tasted Espagueti Verde (Green Spaghetti) you're missing out! This easy and delicious Mexican dish features spaghetti in a creamy, non-spicy poblano sauce. Perfect as a side dish or the star of your meal.
SPAGHETTI VERDE INGREDIENTS:
► Some salt
► 1 lb. spaghetti
► 3 roasted poblano peppers
► 8 oz cream cheese
► 1/2 cup crema Mexicana
► 3/4 cup whole milk
► 1/4 small white onion
► 2 garlic cloves
► Small bunch of cilantro
► 2 tsp chicken bouillon
► Some butter
► Queso seco (grated dry white cheese) Optional

Shibuya(Tokyo) / 渋谷🇯🇵
Shibuya Scramble Crossing is one of the world’s busiest intersections, with up to 3,000 people crossing at once. It’s especially popular with foreign tourists, who make up about 60% of pedestrians during peak times. The term “scramble” describes the chaotic yet organized movement of people, and a unique “silent filming relay” culture has emerged among tourists. Its origins date back to around 1952, with Shibuya’s valley-like topography influencing the current flow of people.

渋谷スクランブル交差点は、一度に最大3,000人が横断する世界有数の混雑を誇る交差点です。外国人観光客に特に人気で、ピーク時には歩行者の約6割を占めます。「スクランブル」とは、人々が混ざり合って行き交う様子を表し、外国人観光客の間ではスマホを渡し合う「無言の撮影リレー」というユニークな文化も生まれています。その原型は1952年頃まで遡り、渋谷の谷の地形が現在の人の流れに影響を与えていると言われています。

🛑 Stop #10: Cartoon Network Hotel – Lancaster, PA 🎨🏨🍭

857 miles to go, 2 stops left, and this one?? The boys lost their minds (in the best way). 🤯💥 From the moment we walked in, it was like stepping inside a cartoon—and not the background character kind. We’re talking full-blown animated adventure energy. 🎬📺🌈

The theming here is immaculate — from Ben 10 to the Powerpuff Girls, every corner was a photo op and every hallway was a new surprise. Our room even had a bunk bed cave situation that basically turned bedtime into a mission from a Saturday morning special. 😴🚀🛌

With the pool, splash pad, arcade, and on-site dining, it was kid heaven — but also surprisingly relaxing for us too. ✌️🧖‍♀️☕

If you’ve got littles and you’re passing through PA? This stop is non-negotiable. It’s not just a hotel, it’s a whole vibe.

🎥 Come along as we road trip 2,185 miles with two toddlers, one minivan, and zero chill. Just 2 wild stops left before we hit the finish line!

venueName: motion stays with them for life
caption:
So apparently when your cat “makes biscuits,” they’re not just pretending to be a tiny baker 😭 It’s actually something super sweet and instinctive. When cats are kittens, they knead their mom’s belly to help with milk flow — and that motion stays with them for life. It becomes their way of showing comfort and love, like saying “I feel safe here.” 🖤

So when your cat starts making biscuits on you, it means they trust you. You’re their safe space, the same way their mom once was. Some behavior experts even say cats knead to leave their scent — basically claiming you as theirs 🥹

So yeah… next time your cat makes biscuits on you, just know that’s love (and ownership) in its purest form 😭🐾 #cat #cats #catlover #blackcat #fyp

caption:
our impromptu fuji trip! 
tak plan pun nak pergi actually. we went for fuji Q sebab nak naik rides je lepastu tetiba lawooo pulak tempatnya?! one of our best highlights in Japan. makes me realise that this is even more fun than ANY shopping. therapeutic and so soul cleansing as well. to see the beauty of Gods creation is truly such a blessing. it’s mesmerising. i will work even harder just to do this again. You will never be this young and reckless again babe so GO FOR THAT IMPROMPTU TRIP! also we didn’t have anything to wear nasib baik ada sweats kat 7E and we kinda swap our outerwear (smart gworls) and fuji sejuk so tak peluh alhamdulillah! but minus pointnya adalah… makanan kat sana tak sedap. it was barely decent pun? matcha dia macam???? we had to go to a very expensive shop nearby to get our dinner. sebab halal kan susah cari, japan pulak kicap pun nak letak alcohol so yea… butttt we pulled through tho hehehe overall experience still 10/10

I recently dined at Cilantros in Sandton, Johannesburg, and it was an unforgettable experience. The ambiance was elegant and cozy, and the staff were incredibly welcoming. My three-course meal was exceptional, starting with a delicious appetizer, followed by a perfectly cooked main course, and ending with a stunning dessert. The food was not only beautifully presented but also bursting with flavor.

Overall, Cilantros exceeded all my expectations and provided an unforgettable dining experience. I wholeheartedly recommend this gem in Sandton to anyone looking for a place that combines exceptional cuisine, a warm atmosphere, and top-notch service.

HANDCRAFTED VIRAL FRUIT-SHAPED DESSERTS AT AUTHENTIC MEDITERRANEAN AND EUROPEAN DESSERT SHOP 🥭 These fruit-shaped desserts have been all over social media, and we finally got our hands on them in Houston! In case you didn’t know, they’re filled with fresh fruit and mousse, wrapped in a delicate chocolate shell, and @Suzies Pastry makes them without any food coloring. All of the treats here are handmade daily— so you're not just chasing a viral trend, you're getting a quality dessert! 🧁

We came for the viral fruit desserts, but stayed for the signature treats— like their Dubai chocolate goodies, 14-layered hand-rolled baklava, fresh ice cream, and stunning cakes. We love how thoughtfully crafted everything is, Suzie’s Pastry even grinds their pistachio in-house and uses Callebaut chocolates, so the Dubai chocolate is rich in flavor but not too sweet. Definitely give them a try! ✨

🎃 We went to Shary Road Alpacas Pumpkin Patch in Mission, TX — and we loved it! 🧡
Such a beautiful spot for photos — seriously, every corner is picture-perfect. We took sooo many pics! 📸

✨ Tips if you’re planning to go:
– Come prepared for lines (especially on weekends — it gets packed!)
– Try not to arrive after 6 p.m., that’s when lines get really long 😅
– It’s been around 95°F lately, so bring water and dress light ☀️
– You can walk the alpacas, grab some food and drinks, and just enjoy the vibe 🦙💛

There are even photographers around the entrance — don’t be shy to ask for a photo or their rates!

Overall, come with good vibes and you’ll have such a fun time 💫

Sopa de fideo y taquitos dorados ~
Favorite comfort food 🤎

Easy recipe below 

Taquitos:
2 russet potatoes
1/2 tsp chef merito-Codorniz seasoning 
1/2 tsp black pepper
Splash of milk
12 corn tortillas
Avocado oil to fry taquitos

Caldillo sauce:
3 roma tomatoes, cut into quarters
1/2 tbsp chef merito-Codorniz seasoning 
1 large garlic clove
1/4 of an onion
1 cup water
—
8 oz fideo pasta
2-3 tbsp of olive oil or avocado oil
A few slices of onion
Handful of cilantro 
Serrano pepper, cut a slit down the middle
1 tsp salt
5 cups water

1. Boil potatoes in salted water until fork tender.
2. Peel potatoes, place in a large bowl, mash, mix in chef merito seasoning, black pepper and splash of milk.
3. Warm up corn tortillas, add potato filling, roll into taquito shape, optional to secure with toothpick.
4. Shallow fry taquitos until golden brown on all sides, stand taquitos in a bowl lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.
5. To a blender cup add tomatoes, garlic clove, onion, chef merito seasoning, water. Blend until smooth. Set aside.
6. Heat up a large pot, add olive oil, fry a few pieces of onion, add fideo pasta, toast until golden brown while mixing to keep from burning. Remove onion, pour caldillo sauce, mix. After 30 seconds add 5 cups of water, cilantro bunch, salt and serrano pepper. Cover pot, bring to a slow simmer for about 15-20 minutes or until fideos have cooked through. Taste for salt.
7. Serve your sopita de fideo right away. Top your taquitos with lots of crema and queso. Enjoy together with pickled jalapeños.

SOPA DE FIDEOS CON TAQUITOS DORADOS! 🤤
ingredientes: 

2 papas 
250 gr. chorizo
1/2 taza de queso para derretir
12-15 tortillas 
200 gr. fideos medianos
4 tomates
1/4 cebolla blanca
2 dientes de ajo 
1 puré de tomate 
2 cdas. consomé 
2.5 litros de agua
sal y pimienta al gusto 
un puñito de cilantro
salsa chiltepín @SalsasMexicoLindo
salsa capitán picante negra @SalsasMexicoLindo
queso fresco, crema, aguacate, limón al gusto

procedimiento:
comienza cociendo la papa. una vez lista llévala a un recipiente y sazona con ajo en polvo, pimienta y sal. añade el chorizo previamente frito. procura guardar un poco de chorizo para el final. agrega también el queso y mezcla muy bien. 
licúa los tomates, cebolla, ajos, puré, consomé, 1/2 litro de agua y la sal y pimienta al gusto. 
en una ollita con un poco de aceite agrega los fideos, mezcla constantemente y cuando estén doraditos incorpora la salsa de tomate. cuando comience a hervir agrega el resto del agua, el cilantro, tapa y deja hervir hasta que la sopa esté cocida a tu gusto. 
haz los taquitos agregando la papa con chorizo y queso a las tortillas, enrolla y fríelos en aceite bien caliente.
sirve la sopa y acompaña con crema, queso, chorizo, salsa chiltepín, salsa capitán picante negra, limón y los taquitos dorados.

caption:
Come renovate my 80s Johannesburg kitchen with me 🧱🇿🇦

I’m sharing some of the design details I’ve poured over in bringing this space to life over the past couple months. You know I always share suppliers and the bits I incorporate into my projects, so I’m sharing those details here in case you’re interested. I’m still finalising some of the details which I’ll share as the project unfolds. 

I’m working with Blueleaf Designs on the custom design and manufacture of our kitchen; the process has been a dream so far. We spent so much time perfecting and nuancing every detail and inclusion. I’ve chosen timber detailing and carcasses from Sonae Arauco and I love that the internals of the cabinetry will be a gorgeous cotton colour instead of white. For hardware and specialised internal components I’m using Roco, they have everything you could ever dream of for your kitchen and have been so helpful. I’ve gone with my favourite Cloudburst Concrete tops from @Caesarstone SA, the dreamiest tones and texture. I’ve chosen a tap, double scullery sink with a garbage disposal unit from Franke. And the one thing I designed into our plan from the start was integrated appliances from Smeg. Eep!

The kitchen will have a big gas-strut window that opens up to what was the old drying yard. My plan is to turn this into a kitchen garden and fill it with edible things. And the plan is to incorporate a counter there so that friends can sit in the garden if I’m busy in the kitchen. And drink gin. We will be drinking gin there. 

Please leave me a comment and let me know what you think. I can’t wait to share more as it comes to life 🫶🏼

ad @SINI 🫶🏼 | here are 5 tips to clean smarter not harder 🫧 first hack is my favourite one!!!

All products are from SINI, use code IDA10 for a discount at their website, link in my bio 💙

5 ways to clean smarter not harder ⬇️

1. use a floor squeegee to lift dust and hair from carpets - the floor squeegee I used is part of the SINI system where you can attach multiple tools to one telescopic shaft 👌🏼

2. keep your shower drain clean for longer with a drain hair catcher, this will make bathroom cleaning SO much easier - you just replace it monthly and your drain stays clean so much longer 🫶🏼

3. run a hot cycle with citric acid to refresh your washing machine - this will make your machine and your clothes smell so good, I do this at least once a month 🧽

4. electrostatic cloths make dusting so much easier and faster - this is the ultimate lazy girl hack, if you struggle with dusting or hate vacuuming you NEED to try these 😮‍💨

5. use a dust sword to reach all those tricky spots - this tool is a GAME CHANGER, it reaches all the difficult places and you can wash it in the washing machine 🫧
